summarize_emit_display_records: summarize emit_display_records which collects rank info and input_ids from a polars DataFrame and emits display records to the report sink
build_render_polars_as_text: build a function that renders a polars DataFrame into a formatted text table string with a title
render_polars_as_rich_table: render a polars DataFrame as a Rich Table object with column headers and row data
collect_rank_info: collect unique rank rows with parallel info metadata from a polars DataFrame filtered by input_ids name
collect_input_ids_and_positions: collect input_ids and positions data per step and rank from a DataFrame, optionally decoding tokens with a tokenizer
